about_the_game:
Pushkin vs Vampires

A poetic top-down shooter where Russian literature gets bloody.

Step into the shadowed streets of 19th-century St. Petersburg.

When the sun sets, the capital of the Russian Empire transforms into a hunting ground for vampires. Grand archways hide sinister whispers, damp alleys drip with danger — and tonight, your wife has been taken by the Dark Prince for a blood ritual.

You are Alexander Sergeyevich Pushkin, the greatest poet of Russia… and its last hope.

A legendary vampire hunter will teach you the dark craft of slaying. Now it’s a race against time: defeat the spawns of the night, rescue your beloved, and stop the ritual before dawn.

Key Features

Fast, brutally satisfying combat

Switch between four unique weapons with infinite ammo —

- Queen of Spades — elegant rapier duels

- Three — rapid stake launcher

- Seven — powerful blackpowder musket

- Ace — sharp and deadly pistol

No reloading. No mercy. Only killing.

Eight vicious vampire types

Each enemy demands a different strategy. Misjudge them, and you’ll become their dinner.

A world straight out of 19th-century paintings

Handcrafted environments dripping with atmosphere — from cannibal restaurants to gothic palaces hosting blood-soaked masquerade balls.

Hypnotic soundtrack

An explosive mash-up of classical symphonies and aggressive dubstep that keeps your heart pounding and your blade swinging.

Secrets & Easter eggs

Track down legendary vampire hunters and discover hidden references for lore lovers.

Why you’ll love it

Dynamic top-down action, a dark and mysterious plot, and the charm of a forgotten era.

This is Pushkin as you’ve never known him, fighting for love in a city teeming with death.

She’s out there…

Right now, the Dark Prince’s claws are closing around your wife.

Her fate depends on you — poet, duelist, vampire killer.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of graphic violence: Murders, bloodthirsty vampire bites, murders, dismemberment. And also light erotic scenes (a brothel with courtesans).
